text: Chapter 10: The Lost God's Ship@Navigator of the Ark
The Wind Ark has been raised but it cannot be\nnavigated. For now, return to Nov Saterica to ask\nKunon if she knows anyone who can navigate it!
Before going to Nov Diela, the city-state that is being\nsurrounded by something, go to Rokoko City Ruins to offer\npaper flower to Ronfa's stone monument at Pino's request!
Coenubia monsters are all over Rokoko City Ruins.\nKeep moving while defeating the monsters and\nfind Ronfa's stone monument!
As you approach the stone monument to offer the paper\nflower, a black shadow wrapped in eerie armor appears from\ninside and attacks you. Eliminate it to protect yourself!
Go to Witch's Woods to collect the Fragrant Gravels\nhated by the monsters appearing around the stone monument\nas requested by the ghost!
[[N]]Find Ronfa's stone monument in Rokoko City Ruins
[[N]]Report to the ghost in Rokoko City Ruins
